description: Shares one image or PDF (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF or PDF, not SVG) as a new site with a viewer and a Download button: without content, returns a link where the user drops their file; with name and content (base64, up to 10 MB) it is published at once.

name.description: With content: file name with extension, e.g. menu.pdf

name: share_file
title: Share a file
